name: Content correction

## Article or page

Link to the Equinox Haber article/page, or paste the slug/title if the link is unavailable.

## What should be corrected?

Describe the factual correction, editorial concern, source-quality issue, or missing context.

## Suggested source or evidence

Please link to primary sources or reliable references when possible. Short excerpts are fine; do not paste full third-party article bodies.

## Why this matters

Explain the impact on accuracy, context, attribution, or reader understanding.

## Safety note

This template is for content corrections and editorial concerns, not security vulnerabilities. For sensitive security issues, use the repository security reporting path instead of a public issue.

Do not include private data, secrets, cookies, tokens, unpublished queue/runtime data, or full copyrighted article text.
